summary: - **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)** — Fixes Marlin random seed refreshing in `MarlinProcessorWrapper`. A new `LCEvent` was often allocated at the same address as the previous one, so the seed refresh was skipped and processors reused identical random streams across events. Wrapped Marlin jobs that use random smearing will now produce different results.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)** — `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the whole HepMC3 event position, so beam particles also start at the smeared interaction point instead of staying at (0,0,0). Fixes #63; the fix has been confirmed by users.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)** — `HepMC3EventReader` now applies the HepMC3 length unit to the primary vertex x/y/z. Previously, primary vertex positions were wrong for input files using centimetres.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)** — `Geant4EventAction` now throws when shared actions are used in single-threaded mode, which previously caused silent wrong behaviour such as events written twice by user output plugins. The DDSim multi-threaded user output plugin example is corrected; steering files that mark output actions as shared must adapt.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#391](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/391)** — The IDEA and ALLEGRO ddsim steering files now set the user output plugin's shared flag only in multi-threaded mode and use the common kernel. This keeps them compatible with the new DD4hep shared-action check (AIDASoft/DD4hep#1677).

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)** — Fixes the `OverlayTiming` background cursor. `StartBackgroundEventIndex` was reapplied every event, so the same background events were overlaid repeatedly, and `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` was never enforced. Jobs that relied on silent reuse of background events now fail unless `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` is set.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#441](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/441)** — Fixes three `CollectionMerger` problems. `Copy=True` threw an exception, an empty `InputCollections` caused a writer segfault and is now rejected at initialization, and exceptions during merging no longer leak the partial output.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)** — Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`. New options add the hit time as a CKF measurement (`UseHitTimeInCKF`), set per-sensor time resolutions (`HitTimeResolutions`), and enable the ACTS doublet seed time cut (`SeedFinding_DoubletTimeCutNSigma`). The time resolutions are a placeholder until EDM4hep stores a per-hit time error.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)** — Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg` together with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`. Users must migrate to `CKFTrackingAlg`; v00-05 is the last tag containing the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)** — `ConformalTracking` gains `ECalBarrelFaceSystemID` and `ECalEndcapFaceSystemID` properties (defaults unchanged for CLD/ILD), so track states at the calorimeter face work for detectors such as ALLEGRO. `GaudiDDKalTest` now also recognises EM calorimeters by type flags, and a missing calo-face state no longer fails the track fit.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes `TracksFromGenParticles` with `ExtrapolateToECal=False`. In that mode, uninitialized ECAL geometry was still read, so tracks could randomly get garbage calorimeter track states. The fix also corrects 64-bit cellID handling, and a failed geometry lookup now returns failure instead of throwing.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/102)** — Refactors `GGTFTrackFinder` and fixes wire-hit collection indexing when there are multiple wire inputs. Noise/unclustered hits (cluster ID ≤ 0) no longer produce an output track, and track type 1 is no longer used, so downstream fitter configurations may need updating.
